Getting to know you

Introduce yourself in Thai and handle the questions that come back. This beginner topic covers getting to know someone — giving your ชื่อเล่น (nickname), saying which ประเทศ (country) you're from and where you อาศัย (live), and answering about your age, job, and whether you're แต่งงาน (married) yet. It moves on to family, how long you've been in เมืองไทย (Thailand), and modestly admitting your Thai is ยังไม่เก่ง (not good yet). All 29 sentences come with native-speed audio, English translations, and word-by-word notes, so the everyday small-talk phrases sink in by ear.

29 sentences · Click each sentence to reveal Thai, English, and notes

1 ชื่อname…
คุณชื่ออะไรคะ
khun chûue à-rai khá
What is your name?
คุณ/ khun=youชื่อ/ chûue=nameอะไร/ à-rai=whatคะ/ khá=polite particle (female)
2 ชื่อname…
ผมชื่อโทบี้ครับ
phǒm chûue thoo-bíi khráp

ผม/ phǒm=I (male)ชื่อ/ chûue=nameโทบี้/ thoo-bíi=Tobyครับ/ khráp=polite particle (male)
3 ชื่อเล่นnickname…
คนไทยมักมีชื่อเล่นนะคะ
khon thai mák mii chûue-lên ná khá

คนไทย/ khon thai=Thai person / Thai peopleมัก/ mák=usuallyมี/ mii=haveชื่อเล่น/ chûue-lên=nicknameนะ/ ná=softening particleคะ/ khá=polite particle (female)
Most Thais have a short one or two syllable nickname used in everyday life — often quite different from their formal name.
